description: Top known-exploited CVEs (CISA KEV) ranked by Patchfirst priority, optionally filtered to known ransomware use, an ATT&CK tactic (e.g. "initial-access", "Privilege Escalation", "TA0004") or a technique id. Each result lists its techniques with provenance badges.

ransomware_only.description: Only KEV entries with known ransomware campaign use.

tactic.description: ATT&CK tactic id, name or TA id. One of: reconnaissance, resource-development, initial-access, execution, persistence, privilege-escalation, defense-evasion, stealth, defense-impairment, credential-access, discovery, lateral-movement, collection, command-and-control, exfiltration, impact

technique.description: ATT&CK technique id, e.g. "T1190"; parent ids include sub-techniques.

name: list_exploited
title: List exploited CVEs
